description:
Every doctype in this app hangs off the **Cova Clinic** workspace, and the sidebar on the left mirrors it.

Two of them you fill in yourself — **Cova Clinic Settings** and **Medical Case**. The rest are written *for* you: COVA pushes visits, test results and monthly reports in through the integration, and the clinic's own check-ins arrive the same way. The steps below walk the sidebar top to bottom.
name: Find Your Way Around the Cova Clinic Workspace
title: Find Your Way Around the Cova Clinic Workspace
